top_choice_rationale: P001 is the one proposal where topic, maturity and allocation all hold: Buchwald and Hartwig independently made palladium-catalyzed C-N coupling general through ligand control of amido-palladium chemistry and difficult C-N reductive elimination, a different mechanistic problem from the 2010 C-C couplings, confirmed for three decades, and the two-name prize forces no omission; Kosugi's precedent can be handled in the citation wording. P002 follows because targeted protein degradation is conceptually new and independently confirmed, though no degrader is approved and the PROTAC and glue strands are not cleanly reconciled; P003 is the same field with the Handa allocation. P004 and P005 have real chemistry but face chemistry-versus-genomics/medicine classification and contested credit, and any award ranks above no award.
recusal_note: No scientific conflict apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski is a professional, not scientific, connection, and my field (electron crystallography of porous materials) is not on the slate.
